newsitem.title: USA: U.S. PLAINS FED CATTLE BID $64, PASSED - FEEDLOTS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. PLAINS FED CATTLE BID $64, PASSED - FEEDLOTS.

text.p: U.S. Plains cattle bids early Tuesday were light at $63.00 to $64.00 per cwt amd passed by owners asking $65.00 to $66.00, feedlot sources said.
Fed cattle prices this week were seen steady with sales late last week at $64.00, but could firm if beef prices stabilize following last week's steep declines, they said.
However, beef prices could weaken if retail demand does not strengthen, some sources said.
"It all depends on what happens in the beef market and on the board " a Kansas feedlot manager said, referring to CME live cattle futures.
